_doc: PROVENANCE (2026-08-28, SESSION 58): the skipful take mc1hwl0.mgcr and its repaired copy mc1hwl0-fixed.mgcr were CERTIFIED (devs=0, 50,142/50,142, END, both instruments) and then DELETED by player ruling — the skipful capture existed for fixture harvest and is fully harvested. recordings/mc1hwl0.mgcr is now the former mc1hwl0-noskip take (53,053 ticks, skip-free). Fixtures with source 'mc1hwl0' were cut from the RETIRED skipful take: their ticks do NOT index the current recording and they cannot be re-cut (the files below remain the assertion). Fixtures with source 'mc1hwl0-noskip' were cut from the take that now carries the mc1hwl0 name.

fixtures.note: THE HW EFFECT CTOR STAMPS THE SAME LINK-TIME MISS CONSTANT: a victim scan that found nothing records 64608 in +146 (the unguarded pointer difference), and the corpus measured 64608 on all thirteen craters — HIDDEN.EXE links its pool at the same offset, so the port's HW gate that kept NewEvent's 0 floored the graded chase lane. mc1hwl0 t=335: the (10,23) crater's chase reads 64608.

THE RIVAL COMMIT STAMPS ITS AIM PITCH ABOVE THE castle bail: retail's sub_155F0 runs cooldown -> +32 -> token +48 with NO castle test in either arm (:19124-27 precision, :19172-76 wide cone) — the stored-mana unlock ladder is the PROJECTILE's own first tick (sub_55DD0 :65049), 40k lines away. The port collapses that fizzle into an emission-time bail, and the bail sat ABOVE the pitch stamp, so a rival whose castle stores nothing stopped aiming altogether. mc1hwl0-noskip t=359: rival 1 (slot 473, castle 522 with f140=0) commits Lightning and its +32 must read 8, not the imported 7.

THE PROBE MEETS THE HUMAN IN RING ORDER (sub_11980 :16988-17027): the out-of-pool carpet is checked as its CELL comes up, ahead of later cells' pool records - the kraken beam stops on the human, not the rival's chain

THE UPGRADE SPACE GATE SCANS GROWTH BANDS, NOT A PERIMETER: sub_12D10 (:17643, HW :15775 - byte-identical twins) reads the OLD half-extents BEFORE the level+1 stamp, takes the growth deltas, and when the half-height delta is zero runs NO terrain test at all; the footprint is 2h tiles from centre-h - the +h row/column an inclusive perimeter tests is retail-never-touched. The four bands carry the MC2 twin's verbatim quirks (side slivers iterate only my rows at oy+my; band 4's first row starts at centre-mx then resets to ox). mc1hwl0 t=971: the human castle's level-2 commit at (232,176) - the 27x27 window is clear except four protected tiles on row cy+hty, exactly the port-only perimeter row, so the port bounced the commit (f59=2) where retail commits: f26 2, f48 4, life 40000, box 3328, manifestation f136 20000/f140 198, and the (10,42) build painter at slot 535 is born. t=1785 is the same law at level 2->3.

THE TARGET SIGNATURE'S TEAM WORD IS A POOL SLOT, SO THE PORT'S HUMAN SENTINEL MUST BE RESOLVED BACK: sub_15420 (:19039) is team + model + class<<7, and 'team' is retail's +24 = the OWNER'S ENTITY SLOT. The importer rewrites every human-owned +24 to the port's PLAYER_TARGET (0xFFFF) sentinel while the stored +148 imports RAW, so a port-side recompute over a human-owned target read 0xFFFF where retail read 472 — the staleness test (sub_15440) refused a target that was perfectly alive and the combat handler returned with NO WRITES, which reads exactly like a one-tick-stale lane and is not one. mc1hwl0 t=1902: rival 1 raids the human's castle 785 (stored sig 858 = 472+2+(3<<7) against a recompute of 385), and its +34 must track the castle at 190, not hold the imported 157.

THE ENEMY-CASTLE PICK WALKS THE TICK-TOP CLASS-3 CHAIN, NOT THE POOL: sub_143A0 (:18507) iterates var_u32_36462[0] and its only per-node tests are '+24 != mine' and '+65 == 2' — membership IS the liveness filter (actLife >= 0 && !(flags & 0x10), sampled once at the tick top). A DEAD CASTLE STILL STANDS: the human's keep 785 takes its fatal hit at t=1920 (act_life 20000 -> -2000, +70 4 -> 6) and is not reap-flagged until t=1921, so a pool scan filtered on 0x400 still saw it and the port re-elected a corpse it could never raid. Retail's chain had already dropped it, so its cascade fell through to the ball claim: +415 7 -> 6, +146 785 -> the mana ball 356.

THE MANA MAGNET STAMPS SOFT-KILLED BALLS TOO — ITS ONLY PER-NODE TEST IS +65 == 39: sub_29920 (:31252) walks the tick-start ball chain with no class test (membership supplies it) and NO 0x400 test. Retail's reap is the NEXT tick's top-of-frame sweep, so a ball collected earlier in this pass keeps its class, model and link and every magnet below it still overwrites its ch4 pair; the ball's ch4 arm then turns +30 to whichever magnet stamped LAST. mc1hwl0 t=2005: ball 823 is flagged between magnets 260 and 786, so its heading must read 957 (the bearing to magnet 787, the last stamper) and not 1888 (magnet 256, the last one before the flag).
THE CORPSE HAND ALIASES THROUGH THE POOL SLOT OF ITS SPELL ID (:55523 model writeback read as a slot): the dead window shows Some(6) at slot 16, not blanket None

THE RIVAL MANIFESTATION MINT IS THE GROUND-JAR CTOR RUN AT THE WIZARD'S OWN POSITION: every retail mint site hands the class-12 thunk &wizard.position — the learn expiry (off_987DE[s].adress(a1 + 72), :19417) and the level-start / respawn re-grants (sub_373F0(&wiz.pos, 12, model), :54900) — and then stamps the token OWNED, +16 |= 1 and +42 = the wizard slot (:19428-29 / :54905-06). The old port mint wrote four fields onto a bare NewEvent and never LINKED it. mc1hwl0 t=2350: rival 1's Armageddon countdown expires and the (12,20) at slot 256 must carry flags 5, +50 = 26, +136 = 5000, +140 = 192, life 0/0 and the wizard's own x/y/z.

THE CASTLE-STORED LADDER IS THE TOKEN'S GATE, NOT THE COMMIT'S: sub_155F0 runs cooldown -> +32 -> +48 = +50 with nothing between (:19124-27, :19172-76) and has no castle test anywhere, so a rival whose castle stores nothing still ARMS its burst; sub_55DD0 (:64917-19) refuses at the TOKEN's own tick one pass later and drops +48 to 1 for the shared decrement. The port's collapsed emission-time bail ate the arm exactly as an earlier version of it ate the +32 stamp. mc1hwl0 t=2425: rival 1's Wall of Fire token 256 must read +48 = 26 (26 -> 0 across t=2426/2427), with castle 522 storing 4,490 against HW spell 20's 60,000 requirement.

THE HW WALL-OF-FIRE BOLT LAYS A (10,0) FIRE EVERY FLIGHT TICK: HW's class-9 state-17 handler is sub_54600 (hw:59929), which WRAPS sub_52770_52AB0 — run the generic flight, then, if the bolt survived it (if (+64), the class byte its own free clears), spawn a (10,0) at the bolt's post-move position stamped +16 |= 0x80, +18 |= 1 and +24 = the bolt's owner. Base MC1 has no such wrapper: its state 17 is the bare sub_52770, which is why the port read 'no fire trail'. mc1hwl0 t=2746: the human's bolt is born at slot 822 and retail's very next allocation is the (10,0) at 788, on the bolt's own first flight tick.

THE HW NAPALM CLOUD IS BORN OFF THE TILE CHAIN: sub_3BC60 (hw:43776-77) writes the (10,53) detonation's position DIRECT (+72 = *a1, +76 = a1[4]) with no sub_41CF0 anywhere, exactly like the base-MC1 twin sub_3B8E0 — so the recorded cloud reads flags 0, not the linker's bit 2. mc1hwl0 t=2750: the m16 bolt detonates into slot 494 and its flags must be 0, not 4.

THE RING ITERATOR BURNS ITS OWN LCG STEP BEFORE THE FIRST CELL: hw:29753 steps the cloud's +4 ONCE between sub_11410 and the first sub_114B0, before any cell is read, and only then two per cell. The base-MC1 arm has always carried that pre-draw; the HW twin was missing it, so every HW wall painted its ring off a stream one step behind and every downstream consumer of the cloud's +4 desynced. mc1hwl0 t=2751: cloud 494's first paint — its own +4 and the x/y of the flames at 354/363/822.
A CHASER'S LOST TEST READS THE RECORD'S LIFE SIGN (:21658-61): the tick-head pdead seed follows act_life, so the kraken drops chase on the suicide-write tick and fires no extra beam

THE REBOUND TOKEN PUBLISHES THE OWNER BIT AT ITS OWN POOL SLOT: retail's class-12 state-0x2A handler sub_573F0_57920 (remc1 :65774 / remc1hw :61996) runs the whole sub_55DD0 gate every burst tick, sets the OWNER's +17 bit 7 (our 0x8000 — the deflection bit proj_move_and_hit reads), lands the sub_55E80 debit/pin and takes the shared --(+48). mc1hwl0 t=5592: rival 1's defense cast arms token 479 to 101 at carpet slot 473 and retail's SAME-TICK token pass (479 > 473) publishes carpet flags 12 -> 32780 and decrements to 100 — the port's refresh-driven publisher lagged the bit one tick and held the counter one above retail for the burst's whole life.

THE SHIELD TOKEN IS THE REBOUND SKELETON WITH A SET-ONLY BIT: sub_566C0 (:65266, class-12 state 12) is sub_573F0 with +17 0x40 (our 0x4000) and NO clear arm — the damage intake clears per absorb (:55700-07), so an expired shield still quarters one hit. mc1hwl0 t=5593: the defense ladder falls through to Shield (Rebound live since 5592), the commit debits -1000 and retail's same-tick token pass publishes carpet 473's flags 0x800C -> 0xC00C; the refresh-driven port paid but never published, and no rival shield ever quartered a hit.

THE HEAL TOKEN HEALS ITS OWNER AT ITS OWN POOL SLOT: sub_56270_567A0 (remc1 :65091 / remc1hw :61313, class-12 state 3) is a body of its OWN, not the launcher skeleton -- admission is the sub_55DD0 gate AND actLife < maxLife AND the purse covers the token's live +136 cost, ALL on every tick (:65102-05); an admitted tick restores 5% of the life CEILING capped (:65108-12), plays sound 25 on the FULL tick only, and debits the WHOLE cost on the owner's regen delta with NO mid-burst pin (:65113-19 -- the positive-arm write is behind remc1's //fix comment-out and is live in the binary: retail f132 reads -1000); a refusal releases the burst (+48 = 1). mc1hwl0 t=17051: rival 1 eats a quartered 25 through the shield, casts Heal at carpet slot 473, and retail's SAME-TICK token pass (478 > 473) restores life 9975 -> 10000 capped and parks the delta at -1000 -- the port's refresh-driven heal ran a pass late and paid cost/count from the purse, reading 9995 on the graded life lane.

THE WALKER SOFT-KILLS A STATE WITH NO TABLE ROW, UN-TICKED: the main walk direct-indexes table[class][state] and requires the row's own state word to match (data4 == +70); a miss takes the 'STATE-ID does not match' arm -- sub_41E80's soft-kill bit, no handler, and NO +63 tick, because retail's phase increment (:52406) sits INSIDE the dispatched branch. Reachable through the death handoff's blind +52 stamp (sub_1A6C0 :21702): the dying packmate writes chase = base+2 into whatever occupies the stale slot. mc1hwl0 t=18600: griffon 162 dies still pointing at slot 109 -- re-minted as the castle guard's (9,13) arrow -- and stamps it f146=17, +70=50 (m8's chase); retail's next walk finds no class-9 row 50, reap-flags the arrow un-ticked (t=18601: flags 8198 -> 9222, f63 parked 118) and the tick-top reap frees it at 18602. The port's old no-op arm ticked f63 forever and the arrow never died.

THE PICK GATES READ THE RAW WIZEXT+50 REGISTER, NOT AN ESTABLISHMENT LATCH: the AttackWizard/RaidCastle entry gates (:18506/:18553 `!+50 && sub_14E60(0x10)`) and the bully clauses (:18570-72) test the +50 word -- bound the moment the free plant mints the castle (:19206) -- and the token half is OWNS-the-m16-token (sub_14E60), not knows-spell-16. The port's `flags & 2` established reading refused the whole wizard pick on the plant tick, so the same-tick re-decision fell through to HuntMana (13, target 161) where retail's war arm picks the human RANGELESSLY (8, target 472, sig 856). mc1hwl0 t=18950: rival 473's f146 must read 472. [The same pair also exercises the box-stamp law -- sub_12C50/sub_12D10 stamp sub_37150's quad entry@level+1/exit@level, reaching the newborn castle through this admission -- but f78-f84 on (3,2) are UNGRADED lanes, so the stamp is pinned by unit test (features.rs the_fit_tests_stamp_the_castle_box), not by this fixture.]

THE TELEPORT RESOLVE IS A RECORD WRITE -- SAME-TICK WALKERS PROBE THE DESTINATION: the (12,10) token fires at its OWN walk slot (:65554 resolve at +48 == +50), and the castle arm's CopyEntityPosition (:65589-98) rewrites the wizard RECORD right there, so every walker dispatching after the token reads the warped pose. mc1hwl0 t=20039: the resolve at slot 30 warps the human 57785/57447 -> 26562/48143 and retail's (9,0) trackers at slots 178/287/360 re-aim on the vanished target the SAME tick -- slot 178 target_yaw 1615 (not the stale-ctx 1014), slot 287's range guard drops chase -> 0. The port pinned the walkers' human pose at tick top. [The same resolve also zeroes the caster's flight TARGET speed (:65583) visible to the same-tick carpet mover -- boundary act_speed 64, cmd_speed 0, dest + one 64-step -- but the pair grader warp-gates the pose channel, so that half is pinned by unit test (world.rs the_teleport_resolve_speed_zero_reaches_the_same_tick_mover), not by this fixture.]

THE INVISIBLE TOKEN RUNS ITS OWN MACHINE AT ITS POOL SLOT -- AND A GATE REFUSAL FIZZLES THE BURST INSIDE THE COMMIT TICK: retail's sub_571B0_576E0 (hw :61899, class-12 state 36) is the sub_573F0 skeleton with the owner's +16 0x20 cloak bit (FULL tick: bit on + wizext+331 grace zeroed + 55E80 full-cost debit; broken-bit or 55DD0 refusal: +48 = 1; the shared decrement clears the bit at 0). mc1hwl0 t=20698 pair: rival 473's flee re-decision commits Invisible (cooldown[12] arms, +48 = +50 = 251) and the token's own pass at slot 481 -- above carpet 473, SAME tick -- gate-refuses on the castle-store ladder, so the burst dies 0 -> 251 -> 1 -> 0 intra-tick and slot 481's f26 must read 0 at the boundary (the Wall-of-Fire spike shape). The port's inert rival (12,12) token kept the armed 251 and the refresh mirror cloaked a wizard retail never hid.

THE ROW-0 QUAD GATE'S BELOW-PLANE BYTES 63/65 (the second half of the OOB smoother law). sub_360C0's gate indexes mapTerrainType SIGNED-32 (:42912-19), so a cell (x,0) tests shim[x] and shim[x+1] -- sound-driver bytes at CC117..CC126 -- but ONLY once its four IN-PLANE reads pass. t=21282's 16-wide collapse never rubbled (62..65,0): they kept building types 12/27/27/79 and failed in-plane, leaving their shim bytes untested, which is why {56,59,71} alone read as the whole table. mc1hwl0 t=24739 is castle 233's SECOND collapse, an 8x8 footprint (x 60..67) that DOES rubble them and retiles them to type 1 -- and retail still declines to smooth (62,0)/(64,0)/(65,0) while smoothing (61,0)/(66,0), which forces shim 63 and 65 building. The consequence is the head: (64,0) keeps the knock-down 163 instead of averaging to 150, so the ejector's ground read is 5216 not 4800, every spill ball is born with f46 8 not -44, and the nine (10,39) balls land at z 6184 not 6132.

THE EMIT ARMS WRITE THE LIVE AIM PAIR +30/+32 AND NOTHING ELSE. sub_579D0's storm emit (:66036-38, hw:62258-60) stamps +30 and +32 off the caster and leaves +34/+36 at the NewEvent zero; the carrier's own first tick is what mirrors them, in proj_m12_tick's one-shot acquire prologue and only on a MISS. Ours mirrored them at the cast, publishing a bearing retail has not written yet: mc1hwl0 t=26716 borns the (9,12) carrier at slot 182 with retail target_yaw 0 against our 340. cast_bomb's (9,18) fuse (:66275-76) is the same arm and was fixed with it.

THE HOUSE SCANS WALK +36470, NOT THE POOL. sub_20710's wyvern house hunt (:26041-48) walks var_u32_36462[2] -- the roster the tick-top sweep builds for class-10 model-45 records (:52301-11) -- and its loop body is the distance pair and NOTHING else: no class, no model, no life, no 0x400. Class and liveness come entirely from MEMBERSHIP, which is sampled once, at the top. mc1hwl0 t=29614 is a village mass-spawn: houses 18..21 and the wyvern at slot 23 are all born in the same tick, so the ascending walk reaches 23 with house 18 already in the pool 2,510,368 units^2 away -- inside the row-25 4608^2 radius. Our pool scan took it and promoted to CHASE (f146 18, state 98); retail's roster predates all four houses, finds nothing, and stays in WANDER. The m12 settler SEEK (:25241) and the m13/m14 feeder acquire (:25422/:25598) walk the same list and were routed with it.

THE RE-ARM IS NOT A TICK OF ITS OWN. sub_25EC0's dormant block (:28749-64) clears +26 and has NO return, so it falls straight into the activation test whose `|| !+26` arm is now TRUE -- the tick that wakes a volcano is the tick it erupts. Ours returned after the re-arm and paid for the eruption one tick later on a driver LCG that had already moved on. mc1hwl0 t=35674, driver slot 754 at f26 2597: retail borns the (10,19) plume at 518, the (10,16) lava bomb at 452 and the eruption-start (9,0) blast at 364, and advances +30 by 0x500 (39680 vs our 38400). The same pair pins the START's two BLIND register writes (:28779, :28791): the only gate on either is `slot != 0`, so the kick and the plume reap-flag land on whatever record now holds the slot -- here a (10,0) fire that re-minted the dead plume's 404.

THE PORTAL VORTEX WARPS EVERY WIZARD: the warp scan walks the wizard list (sub_26A60 :29199-29223, var_u16_10 — carpet ent through wizard+10; HW byte-identical :27714-68), human first then each rival's carpet by its pool record, cone on the CARPET's f30; per warp the portal re-stamps its OWN site_z = row156 v_12 + terrainAlt(dest) BEFORE the verbatim sub_41C70 move, and snd 22 fires at the PORTAL's slot. mc1hwl0 t=10250: rival carpet 473 rides the vortex 51 tiles; the human-only scan left it hovering at the mouth. Ledger SESSION 62 law 1.

THE RAID CASTLE-PICK'S UNDEFENDED TEST HAS A THIRD CONJUNCT: :18518 — undefended also requires !sub_11950(ownerCarpet, castle) on the pool record AT the castle's id24 (id24 IS the owner's carpet pool slot); the human's carpet is out-of-pool, its arm runs the sprite-44 box on the live pose. A grown keep's summed extents reach past the 7680 disc, so a carpet parked over its own keep's corner still defends it. mc1hwl0 t=15800-18: 19 pairs where the y-leg of the overlap holds the veto until retail elects at 15820. Ledger SESSION 62 law 2.

A CORPSE IMPORTS AND HOLDS ITS WRAPPED-NEGATIVE PURSE: the import seeded player.mana (and the rival twin) as f140.max(0), eating the corpse's held shortfall at every anchor - retail holds -100 = 4294967196 for the whole 69-tick corpse window (t=23462-23530) until the respawn re-mint (:54998). Both seeds are now BIT-COPIES (conformance.rs). Ledger SESSION 64 Shield/Rebound arm (a), import half.

THE REBOUND DEFLECTION QUARTER DEBITS THE DEFLECTOR, AFFORD-GATED, AND THE BIT REPUBLISHES MID-WALK: all four deflect sites (:62725/:62863/:63129/:63734) subtract quarter(projectile +140) from the DEFLECTOR's purse at the PROJECTILE's walk slot, gated quarter <= purse (unsigned) on the payload pair f68/f69 (a (9,0) m16 bolt carries (10,1) and deflects); the port's MailTarget::Player arm had neither gate nor debit ('INTERIM'), and the g.player_rebound mirror was tick-head-stale, so a re-cast's fresh 0x8000 was invisible to same-tick bolts above the token's slot. mc1hwl0 t=38739: the re-cast at carpet 472 republishes, bolt 949 (f140 200) deflects and the human pays the 50 quarter; the port had refused the deflection (plain hit, extra (10,0) impact, +50 purse). The human debit rides Gen.player_deflect_debit (wizard pass pre-step / tick-tail raw, retail's below/above-carpet order). Ledger SESSION 64 Shield/Rebound arm (b).

THE CH3 THIEF BANKS THE FULL STEAL, NOT THE CLAMPED TAKE: retail's intake (:55689-91) subtracts the full amount raw from the victim (+140, no clamp - the same-dispatch regen step is the only floor, signed so an over-steal eats the quantum) and credits the attacker the FULL amount even off a broke victim. The port clamped both sides (.min(mana) at the two rivals.rs intake sites): mc1hwl0 t=23438+ slot 473, the thief reads 100 where the clamped take banked 0, x24. The rival purse step now reads the purse as signed 32 (:55385-91) so wrapped shortfalls floor at 0. Ledger SESSION 64 Shield/Rebound arm (c).

A DEAD HUMAN IS A DEAD CHASE TARGET, AND OFF THE MANA-HUNT CHAIN: the genie chase's target test (:24636, +12>=0 && !(+17&4) && +64) reads the human's carpet like any pool record - the PLAYER_TARGET arm's hardcoded alive was a port invention (t=23461 slot 697: retail eats a ball +500 and blinks home, f146/f26 -> 0). The genie mana hunt (:24527) walks the tick-top class-3 chain built with actLife>=0 (:52254) - MEMBERSHIP is the liveness filter, so the corpse is unelectable (t=23503/23504 slots 696/695: retail chase 0, the port elected the corpse and teleported onto the body). Same law family: wyvern_chase (:26152, mc1l49 t=3059) and the m15 guard's target-loss test. Ledger SESSION 65.

THE TRIGGER VOLUME'S FIRE PROBE READS THE TICK-TOP CLASS-3 ROSTER, AND A DEAD CARPET IS NOT ON IT: sub_5A090 (hw:63902-18, base :67632-48) walks var_u32_36462[0] filtered to model 0; the roster's case-3 arm (hw:48303-13, base :52253-62) gates actLife >= 0 - so the falling corpse inside (11,2) volume 179's box at t=23480 can trip nothing, the probe MISSES regardless of want and takes the z re-stamp path. The port's ungated pose probe armed f26=10 and minted six (10,17)s, and the fire_disposition's mc2_rebuild_free displaced the death-cascade puffs (999/984/978/963/959 LIFO) to 161/186. The REARM probe (sub_5A120 hw:63924-38) walks the wizard TABLE with no liveness gate - the asymmetry is retail's. Ledger SESSION 66.

THE CASTLE EJECTOR IS GATED ON POOL HEADROOM AND A MAGNET DRAWS ONLY IF IT ALLOCATED: sub_47130 (:56194-96, hw:52258-60) gates the ENTIRE ball+magnet body on sub_37710_37AD0() - the free-slot COUNT (top index +40 init -1, hw:40471/40217), so an exhausted pool (the mc1hwl0 eruption drained the stack to 0) skips the ejector WITHOUT A SINGLE DRAW; and the magnet loop (hw:52307-20) allocates the (10,54) AT THE CASTLE first, only a successful alloc stamping the owner + drawing the castle yaw + relinking 25 tiles out. The port's fail-open spawns drew 4 unconditional magnet yaws per even-f63 tick, forking castle 340's LCG phase (t=25315/17/19/21/23 - five LOCAL heads, one law). Also: throw count = min(clamp(spill/1000,1,32), free COUNT) - the old +1 misparsed sub_37710. Ledger SESSION 66.

THE MC1 RESPAWN WINDOW SACRIFICES 0x20400 VICTIMS ASCENDING: sub_37220 (:43836-58) rebuilds BOTH stacks - the recycle half collects every live record with flags & 0x20400, pushed DESCENDING 999->1 so the LOWEST victim tops the stack - and NewEvent's second arm (:43885-908) seizes it bare (unlink, memset, defaults; the tick-top roster caches blanked). The wizard re-init sub_44D30 reaps at entry (hw:50910) and disarms at its tail (hw:51124); the death LANDING (:55487) reaps and leaves the stack ARMED; the disposition fire (sub_37440 :43960) and the ejector's empty-pool retry disarm. Witness: mc1hwl0 t=25319 - rival 473 respawns into a 0-free pool and retail's 24-entry re-grant eats 20 village dwellings at slots 1..15,19..23 (16/17/18 fail the mask), consecutive-rand mint signature; the port's respawn minted nothing and left the rival bookless. Ledger SESSION 66 addendum 2.

THE JAR PICKUP WRITES THE ACQUISITION LIST, NOT THE DERIVED OWNED REGISTER: sub_55A40's grant (:64848-61, hw:61070-89) writes +532[v24]/+940/+772 and never +676; +676 is rebuilt wholesale from +532 by sub_45C10 (:55304-19) as the FIRST statement of the wizard's own dispatch (sub_45C90 :55342, hw:51410). The already-known marker reads +676 (:64794) and the grant-refusal reads the live +532 (:64818-31) - two different registers, one variable in the old port. mc1hwl0 t=25497: the human picks spell 18 off jar 187 inside this pair, and the far (12,18) jar 204 - poll tick +63=176, walk slot below carpet 472 - must still read 'not owned' and hold flags 4; it stamps at its NEXT poll, t=25501 (+63=180), after the carpet's rebuild. The port's eager player.owned[spell]=i at the grant stamped it four ticks early. Same law the 'all spells' cheat already works around (cheats.rs mc1_cheat_all_spells). Reversion signature: slot 204 flags retail 4 port 5.

A MILITIA BORN INTO FIRE STILL ZEROES THE WALK-IN FLAG: sub_1B5D0's +26 = 0 is the handler's FIRST statement, ABOVE its inline damage intake (:22482, hw :21039) — it lands on hit and death ticks too. The port zeroed inside the idle body (unreached on Hit/Dead intakes), so a torched-house militia hit on its birth tick kept the ctor stagger (+26 = slot % 100) and sub_1BC10's absorb gate (:22730) swallowed the corpse — no (10,39) 500-mana ball. Witness: mc1hwl0 t=27513 slot 777 (f26 retail 0 vs port 77, the graded charge lane), death at 27515, retail corpse state 29 + ball 876 at t=27516 where the port soft-killed.

A REFUSED STORM BLOOM LEAVES THE CARRIER ALIVE: the (9,12) lightning carrier's self-kill sits INSIDE the (10,38) cloud's null guard - HIDDEN 0x54441 test/0x54443 je 0x544ba jumps past the kill at 0x544b2 (sub_41E80_421C0 @ 0x421C0 is the two-instruction leaf `orb $4,0x11(%eax)` = flags |= 0x400), decompile hw :59852-73 / base :63768-88. So when new_event refuses (free AND recycle both dry) the carrier is NOT marked dead and re-tries its bloom. The port set the flag outside the `if let`. WARNING - the fork is deliberate and does NOT generalise: the WATER arm 20 bytes earlier (0x54408) kills UNCONDITIONALLY, its je 0x54407 skipping only the +24 copy. mc1hwl0 t=37110: the pool goes 5 -> 0 on the tick, retail keeps slot 983 flags 6 against the port's 1030, every other lane and both allocator halves identical.
